name: What is the typical timeframe for a vanity or cabinet installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a vanity or cabinet installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for vanity or cabinet installation varies based on the project's scope, custom designs, and the condition of the existing space. A standard installation of pre-fabricated cabinets might take a few days, while custom cabinetry or extensive remodels, especially in older homes common in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, can extend to several weeks due to custom fabrication and site preparation. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial consultation and site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project scope and customization, from a few days for standard units to several weeks for custom or complex remodels.
